mentions.name: BuildOpsy
mentions.description: BuildOpsy is a site publishing articles on system design, infrastructure failures, and postmortems of costly outages, along with engineering calculators for calculations engineers usually work out in a spreadsheet. Some calculators are available on the site's calculators page.
mentions.problem: Engineers typically have to calculate these things ad hoc in a spreadsheet, even at 2am.
mentions.audience: Engineers, particularly those doing infrastructure and system design work
mentions.source_excerpt:
been building BuildOpsy mostly writing about system design, infrastructure failures and the occasional “well, that was an expensive outage” postmortem.

Also building calculators for things engineers usually calculate in a spreadsheet at 2am. you can see some on the site(https://buildopsy.com/calculators.html)
